notConnected: Onboarding is not connected to its backend yet.
signInPrompt: Sign in to register your company.

problems.attestation-invalid: The verification with the Business Wallet was not accepted ({{reason}}).
problems.attestation-mismatch: The data differ from your company's Business Wallet: {{fields}}.
problems.attestation-used: This verification was already used. Verify again with the Business Wallet.
problems.attestation-expired: Your verification with the Business Wallet is too old. Verify again to submit; your data stays.
problems.account-bound: Your account already belongs to a company. An account can register only one company.
problems.open-application-exists: You already have an application in progress. A person can have one open application at a time.
problems.company-has-open-application: There already is an open application for this company.
problems.company-not-eligible: This company cannot be reactivated or brought back with this application.
problems.documents-disabled: This OSP accepts applications only with a Business Wallet.
problems.documents-incomplete: Something is missing for the review: upload a commercial register extract and confirm that you may represent the company.
problems.consents-incomplete: The terms changed. Read and accept the new version.
problems.invalid-state: The application can no longer be changed.
problems.already-decided: The application can no longer be withdrawn: OSP staff have already decided.
problems.forbidden: Only OSP staff see the applications of this OSP.

start.title: Start application
start.signedInAs: Signed in as {{name}}. You file the application for your company personally; after the approval you become its Company Admin.
start.goalQuestion: What do you want to do?
start.goalNewText: Your company is not yet in the dataspace.
start.goalExisting: My company is already in the dataspace
start.goalExistingText: It was deactivated at this OSP, or it is with another OSP today.
start.kindReactivationText: The company was deactivated at this OSP and comes back.
start.kindTransferText: The company is with another OSP today and moves here.
start.bpnRequiredHelp: Required: the BPN of the company at this OSP, for example BPNL00000000003C.
start.fromOspHelp: The OSP your company is registered with today.
start.bpnReturn: Business partner number (BPN), if it was at this OSP before
start.bpnReturnHelp: Only if your company moved away from this OSP and now comes back, for example BPNL00000000004D.
start.proofQuestion: How do you prove your company?
start.proofEbwText: Your company's wallet confirms its data and that you may represent it. Fastest; the data is filled in for you.
start.proofDocumentsText: You enter the company data and upload a commercial register extract. OSP staff check it by hand.
start.needsEbw: You need: your EUDI Wallet with your personal ID, a mandate for the company, and the company's Business Wallet.
start.needsDocuments: You need: the company's legal name, address and an identifier (for example the VAT ID), and a commercial register extract as PDF, PNG or JPEG.

wallet.title: Verify with your Business Wallet
wallet.intro: The EBW-Connector of your OSP asks your wallets for:
wallet.pid: your personal ID (PID) in your EUDI Wallet,
wallet.mandate: your mandate to represent the company,
wallet.lpid: the company's legal person ID (LPID) in its Business Wallet.
wallet.scanHint: Scan the code with your EUDI Wallet on your phone, or open the wallet on this device.
wallet.qrLabel: QR code of the wallet request of the EBW-Connector
wallet.approving: Confirm the request in your wallet…
wallet.mandateShared: Mandate to represent the company confirmed
wallet.lpidShared: Legal person ID (LPID) of the company shared
wallet.approved: Approved. Your company data is filled in from the wallet…
wallet.cancelled: The verification in the wallet was cancelled.

company.title: Company data
company.locked: From the wallet, cannot be changed
company.saved: Saved. The data was compared with the wallet again.
company.documentsIntro: Enter the data as in the commercial register. OSP staff compare it with the documents you upload next.

source.MATCH: Edited by you, matches the wallet
source.MISMATCH: Edited by you, differs from the wallet
source.NOT_IN_ATTESTATION: Entered by you, not in the wallet

documents.title: Supporting documents
documents.intro: Upload the commercial register extract of {{company}}. If the extract does not name you as a representative, add a power of attorney. PDF, PNG or JPEG.

hint.POWER_OF_ATTORNEY: Only if the register extract does not name you as a representative.
hint.OTHER: Any further document that helps OSP staff.

documents.locked: Your application is submitted; its documents can no longer be changed.
documents.declaration: I declare that I may represent {{company}} and file this application for it.

terms.title: Roles, terms and submission
terms.rolesIntro: What your company will do in the dataspace. The terms below follow from the roles.
terms.rolesSaved: Roles saved; the terms were updated
terms.termsIntro: Open each document and read it to the end to accept it. You consent personally, in the language you read it in.
terms.notAccepted: Not accepted yet: read it to the end and accept it
terms.missing_one: Accept one more document to submit.
terms.submittedText: OSP staff now review the application of {{company}}. You get a notification when they have decided.
terms.reverified: Verified again with the Business Wallet
terms.viewerHintScroll: Scroll to the end of the document to accept it.
terms.viewerHintDone: You read the {{language}} version to the end.

application.title: My application
application.approvedText: {{company}} is active in the dataspace. You are its Company Admin.
application.demoReviewText: Open this application in Application review, approve or decline it, and come back to see what the applicant sees.
application.noConsents: No consents yet; you give them at submission.
application.withdrawText: Possible until OSP staff have decided. You can start a new application afterwards.
application.withdrawConfirmText: The application of {{company}} ends. OSP staff stop the review. This cannot be undone.

staff.title: Applications
staff.decisionElsewhere: The decision is made in the review case (C1-M3 Application Review), not here.
